issues.title: Context Window Truncation of Core Logic
issues.why: The module is ~136KB, exceeding the 120KB cap. The AI coder loses the implementation specs for scripts 13-79, including the critical CI workflow (70) and Auditor (31).
issues.fix: Move the large §98-changelog.md and §99-consistency-report.md to separate files or further archive them to bring the total module size under 100KB.

issues.title: Delegated Acceptance Criteria Blind Spot
issues.why: AC-T-29/30/31 delegate GWT criteria to 50+ external files (NN-*.md) which are not provided in this context, making 100+ criteria invisible to the coder.
issues.fix: Incorporate the GWT criteria for the most critical scripts (05, 24, 31, 70) directly into 97-acceptance-criteria.md instead of delegating them.

issues.title: Missing Reference Implementation Snippets
issues.why: AC-T-32 mandates normative code snippets for R2 file-locking in Python/Node, but these snippets are referenced as being in 00-overview.md and are not present in the provided text.
issues.fix: Explicitly include the Python and Node code blocks for atomic writes and locked-read retries in the 00-overview.md Resilience section.
